attributes.task_description: Update the system requirements to add detection of loss or degradation of any sensor channel within a bounded time, driving the system to the safe state so a silent channel loss cannot go unnoticed. No requirement of the initial system covers this.
Define test to verify alarm stays within L_alarm_min to L_alarm_max.
Define acceptance test for P_fn_close and P_fn_mid at system level covering all specified operating conditions.

Update the system requirements to define a safe state: when detection performance cannot be guaranteed, inform the operator within FTT via a visual indication and a distinct acoustic alert, stating the reason. Review whether all fault conditions leading to the safe state are identified and that the FTT budget is achievable. No requirement of the initial system defines a safe state.

attributes.has_name: Define sensor availability and minimum set per operating condition
attributes.task_description: Update the system requirements to make the diverse-redundant sensor set explicit: specify which modalities are credited in each operating condition (e.g. day = camera + LiDAR + IR, night = LiDAR + IR with the camera not credited), the minimum healthy set that still meets the target, reliability-aware fusion that weights each modality by its current validity, and degradation to the safe state when the healthy set is insufficient for the current condition. The initial requirements list the three sensors flatly without this decomposition.

Update the system requirements to add monitoring that detects when the environment moves outside the specified operating conditions (e.g. heavy rain, blinding light, obstruction) and warns the operator. The monitor must itself detect these situations with sufficient accuracy and be independent of the primary detection path. No requirement of the initial system covers this.

attributes.has_name: Identify conditions that cause missed detection
attributes.task_description: Systematically identify the conditions under which the perception system can fail to detect a tiger (e.g. camouflage, occlusion, thermal ambiguity, glare), then update the system requirements to specify detection performance per condition.
